reason: Root cause proven from both bundles + Angular 16 runtime: Ivy fires input setters in template order (splitPos before splitTopEl) whereas Angular 8 View Engine applied them in directive-declaration order (splitTopEl[0] before splitPos[5]); set splitPos dereferences the not-yet-populated this.splitTopEl -> classList error. App-latent assumption (b) exposed by genuine Ivy ordering change (a); template and component are byte-identical to source (not c). But Angular 16 ships NO vendor mechanism/provider/config to restore VE input ordering, so the packet's prescribed fix shape (vendor-guarded, app-source-unchanged) is unrealizable; the only working generic fix reorders authored template bindings, violating 'App source stays as its authors wrote it'. Made no file changes.
